title: 阿卡丽·竹影高阶
description: 高马尾阿卡丽静立宽石阶，镰刃垂于身侧、苦无收好，斜射日光切开竹林与完整忍者衣装。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Akali is an adult Ionian ninja with a high dark ponytail, focused eyes, a green cloth face covering, and recognizable green-purple costume accents. Preserve her lean athletic adult proportions while fully covering her torso with a fitted long-sleeved ninja jacket, opaque trousers, wraps, gloves, and boots. Her curved kama hangs motionless beside the leg, and her kunai remains securely sheathed.
art_direction.scene: Frame her standing still on a broad stone stair landing, shoulders composed and weight balanced over both feet. A simple line of tall bamboo casts hard diagonal shadows across the steps, while one distant roof edge recedes into pale atmospheric space. Use decisive coarse wax marks and angular light planes; the lowered weapon stays separate from the body and never points toward anyone.
art_direction.palette: deep jade, plum shadow, pale limestone, warm gold light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
